site.name: vaultkey
site.summary: vaultkey-clone Fictional password manager "Vaultkey" — short marketing landing + main pricing page. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Short landing: hero with title / dual CTAs; faux app screenshot (categorized sidebar + searchable item list with passkey / family / 2FA tags); 7-name trust strip; 3 why-cards; bottom CTA | | `pricing.html` | Main page: yearly / monthly billing toggle (annual saves 20%); 3 plan cards (Personal $0 forever, Family $3.99/mo featured, Business per-seat); **Business per-seat slider 3–200 with linked number input**, 5-tier volume pricing (3–24 / 25–49 / 50–99 / 100–199 / 200+) with monthly + yearly totals; enterprise contact strip; 25-row grouped feature comparison table (5 groups: Vault & sync / Sharing / Security / Admin & compliance / Support); 8-question FAQ accordion | | `styles.css` | Brand color #1E1B4B indigo + #A3E635 lime accent; Inter + JetBrains Mono; responsive at 2 breakpoints (>1000 / <1000 / <640) |

run_plan.goal: Evaluate the UX of the Vaultkey marketing site, focusing on the clarity of the pricing model (specifically the Business tier logic) and mobile responsiveness of key navigation elements.
run_plan.summary: The run will start on the landing page to assess value proposition clarity and CTA effectiveness. It will then transition to the Pricing page to rigorously test the billing toggle and the complex Business seat calculator/slider interaction. Finally, it will verify mobile usability, specifically addressing the prescan warnings regarding small tap targets in the navigation.
assumptions: The 'Security', 'Enterprise', and 'Help' links are placeholders (#) or lead to non-existent pages based on the file list, so exploration will focus on Index and Pricing.
The 'Business per-seat slider' on the pricing page is a critical interactive element that requires validation of its min/max bounds and price calculation logic.
The site relies heavily on CSS/JS for the pricing calculator; visual regression and console error checking are vital.
risk_hotspots: pricing.html: Business plan seat slider and linked number input synchronization
pricing.html: Yearly vs Monthly billing toggle state persistence and price updates
Global Navigation: Tap target sizes on mobile viewports (prescan flagged <44px height)

phases.title: Landing Page & Value Prop
phases.objective: Validate the hero section messaging, trust indicators, and primary CTAs on index.html.
key_checks: Verify visibility of 'See plans' and 'Download free' CTAs above the fold.
Check legibility of the faux app screenshot (sidebar categories and item list).
Confirm 'Trusted By' logos are visible and not broken.
Test hover states on primary buttons.
exit_criteria: Hero section fully rendered without layout shifts.
CTAs clickable and leading to correct destinations (Pricing or #).

phases.title: Pricing Logic & Interaction
phases.objective: Deep dive into pricing.html to validate the billing toggle and the complex Business tier calculator.
key_checks: Toggle 'Yearly' vs 'Monthly' and verify all three plan prices update correctly (20% savings logic).
Interact with the Business 'Team size' slider: drag to min (3), max (200+), and intermediate values.
Type directly into the Business seat number input and verify the slider moves in sync.
Verify the '5-tier volume pricing' text updates dynamically as the seat count changes.
Expand/Collapse FAQ accordion items to check for content overflow or animation glitches.
exit_criteria: Prices calculate correctly for edge cases (e.g., 200 seats, yearly billing).
Slider and input field remain synchronized during rapid interaction.
No console errors during DOM manipulation of the pricing calculator.

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness & Accessibility
phases.objective: Address prescan warnings by testing the site on mobile viewport (<640px).
key_checks: Verify navigation menu collapses into a hamburger menu or remains usable.
Measure tap targets for 'Sign In', 'Product', and 'Pricing' links (prescan flagged these as <44px).
Check that the Pricing table/cards stack vertically and remain readable.
Ensure the Business seat slider is usable via touch gestures.
exit_criteria: No horizontal scrolling on main content areas.
Critical navigation links have adequate padding/touch area or are accessible via a mobile menu.

coverage_targets.features: Full exercise of Pricing toggle, Business slider/input, and FAQ accordion
coverage_targets.mobile: Critical path validation on <640px viewport, focusing on nav tap targets

notes: Prescan indicated 'small_tap_target' warnings for almost all nav items. Prioritize checking if these are fixed via CSS media queries or if they remain a usability issue on mobile.
Since 'Security' and 'Enterprise' links appear to be dead ends (#), do not spend steps trying to navigate them unless they reveal hidden modals.

Vaultkey stores passwords, passkeys, 2FA codes, and shared team secrets — encrypted end-to-end with a key only you can derive. Works on every browser, every device, every shell. Vaultkey stores passwords, passkeys, 2FA codes, and shared team secrets — encrypted end-to-end with a key only you can derive. Works on every browser, every device, every shell. See plans → Download free app.vaultkey.io / vault / personal All items 248 Logins 184 Passkeys 23 Cards 9 Notes 32 SHARED Family 14 Engineering 57 ⌘K · search 248 items G github.com m.harlowe · passkey Passkey N netflix.com harlowe.family@… Family F figma.com milena@halcyon.co Engineering S stripe.com milena@halcyon.co · 2FA 2FA L linear.app passkey · synced Passkey TRUSTED BY SECURITY TEAMS AT Halcyon Northwind Vesper Wine Pinecrest PR Atlas Bicycle Holm & Brock Studio Nephele ⌘ One shortcut, every site Cmd-Shift-L drops a passkey or password into whatever's focused. Web, native, and SSH — all the same gesture. ⛒ Real end-to-end Zero-knowledge key derivation. The server can't see your vault, can't reset your master key, and can't impersonate you. ⌥ Shared with intent Share a single item, a folder, or an entire collection. Revoke in a click — and the recipient's local copy is purged on next sync. Stop reusing passwords. Three plans, starting at $0. Personal stays free forever for one device. See pricing → © 2026 Vaultkey, PBC · Boulder, CO SOC 2 Type II · FIDO2 · audited 2025

Yearly · save 20% Monthly Personal For one human and their stuff. $ 0 / month Free forever for one device.
